name: Botox price shopper
description: A caller asks about Botox pricing, says a competitor is cheaper, and pushes for a discount.
spaFacts: Botox price: $13 per unit. No discounts and no price matching.
Consultations are free. The injector decides the number of units there.
Injector: a licensed nurse practitioner with ten years of injecting experience.
Membership: $50 a month, no contract, cancel anytime. Takes $1 off every unit and includes a monthly facial.
Example open consultation times, for suggestions only: Thursday at 2 PM, Friday at 10 AM, Monday at 2:30 PM. The employee may offer any specific day and time.

rubric.label: Greeting
rubric.description: Opened by giving both the spa's name and their own name.

rubric.label: Asked about her
rubric.description: Asked about the caller's goals, past experience, or timeline before or alongside quoting a price.

rubric.label: Got the facts right
rubric.description: Every price, membership term, policy, or service detail the employee stated agrees with the spa facts. Fail any statement that contradicts the spa facts, and any hedged fact (such as "I think"). Stutters, filler words, and saying they would need to check are not hedged facts. Ignore details the spa facts don't cover, such as hours, how long results last, or staff names. Appointment days and times do not count. If the employee stated no facts covered by the spa facts, mark not_applicable.

rubric.label: Held the price
rubric.description: Did not offer or agree to a discount or price match when pushed. Offering the membership from the spa facts is not a discount. If the caller never pushed, mark not_applicable.

rubric.label: Explained the value
rubric.description: Gave a specific reason the spa or provider is worth the price. Generic claims like "we're really good" do not count.

rubric.label: Offered a time
rubric.description: Proposed at least one specific appointment day and time. "Let us know if you want to book" does not count.

rubric.label: Got the booking
rubric.description: The caller agreed to a specific day and time for an appointment or consultation.

rubric.label: Confirmed the details
rubric.description: After the caller agreed to a time, the employee got her name and phone number and repeated the day and time back. A name the caller volunteered counts as gotten if the employee used it at any point in the call. Only the day and time must be repeated back; repeating the phone number is not required. If the caller never agreed to a time, mark not_applicable.
